import sys
from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
from pyspark.context import SparkContext
from awsglue.context import GlueContext
from awsglue.job import Job
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.ml.feature import StringIndexer

args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ["JOB_NAME"])

sc = SparkContext()
glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
spark = glueContext.spark_session
job = Job(glueContext)
job.init(args["JOB_NAME"], args)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# --------------------------------------------------
BUCKET = "propelnoi-vijay-datalake"

TRAINING_INPUT_PATH = f"s3://{BUCKET}/outputs/output_market_rent_training/"
SCORING_INPUT_PATH = f"s3://{BUCKET}/outputs/output_market_rent_scoring_input/"

TRAIN_OUTPUT_PATH = f"s3://{BUCKET}/modeling/market_rent/train/"
VALIDATION_OUTPUT_PATH = f"s3://{BUCKET}/modeling/market_rent/validation/"

# Final target bounds
MIN_TARGET_RENT = 1000.0
MAX_TARGET_RENT = 4500.0

# Global fallback medians
DEFAULT_GLOBAL_PRICE_MEDIAN = 150.0
DEFAULT_GLOBAL_PORTFOLIO_MEDIAN = 2500.0

# --------------------------------------------------
# Read source data
# --------------------------------------------------
print("Reading training and scoring source data as PARQUET...")
train_raw = spark.read.parquet(TRAINING_INPUT_PATH)
score_raw = spark.read.parquet(SCORING_INPUT_PATH)

print("Training schema:")
train_raw.printSchema()

print("Scoring schema:")
score_raw.printSchema()

# --------------------------------------------------
# Basic cleanup
# --------------------------------------------------
train_raw = (
    train_raw
    .withColumn("city", F.trim(F.col("city")))
    .withColumn("room_type", F.trim(F.col("room_type")))
)

score_raw = (
    score_raw
    .withColumn("city", F.trim(F.col("city")))
    .withColumn("room_type", F.trim(F.col("room_type")))
)

required_train_cols = [
    "city",
    "room_type",
    "price",
    "minimum_nights",
    "availability_365",
    "number_of_reviews",
    "review_scores_rating",
    "latitude",
    "longitude"
]

required_score_cols = [
    "city",
    "current_portfolio_rent"
]

missing_train = [c for c in required_train_cols if c not in train_raw.columns]
missing_score = [c for c in required_score_cols if c not in score_raw.columns]

if missing_train:
    raise Exception(f"Missing training columns: {missing_train}")

if missing_score:
    raise Exception(f"Missing scoring columns: {missing_score}")

train_raw = train_raw.filter(F.col("price").isNotNull()).filter(F.col("price") > 0)
score_raw = score_raw.filter(F.col("current_portfolio_rent").isNotNull()).filter(F.col("current_portfolio_rent") > 0)

print("Training rows after filtering:", train_raw.count())
print("Scoring rows after filtering:", score_raw.count())

# --------------------------------------------------
# Stable benchmark-based target engineering
# target = median_city_portfolio_rent * room_type_ratio
# --------------------------------------------------
print("Calculating benchmark-based calibrated target...")

# Median market price by city + room_type from training data
train_group_stats = train_raw.groupBy("city", "room_type").agg(
    F.expr("percentile_approx(price, 0.5)").alias("median_group_price")
)

# Median market price by city from training data
train_city_stats = train_raw.groupBy("city").agg(
    F.expr("percentile_approx(price, 0.5)").alias("median_city_price")
)

# Median portfolio rent by city from scoring data
score_city_stats = score_raw.groupBy("city").agg(
    F.expr("percentile_approx(current_portfolio_rent, 0.5)").alias("median_city_portfolio_rent")
)

# Join stats onto training rows
train_df = (
    train_raw
    .join(train_group_stats, on=["city", "room_type"], how="left")
    .join(train_city_stats, on="city", how="left")
    .join(score_city_stats, on="city", how="left")
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Global fallback medians
# --------------------------------------------------
global_city_price_median = train_raw.selectExpr(
    "percentile_approx(price, 0.5) as med"
).collect()[0]["med"]

global_city_portfolio_median = score_raw.selectExpr(
    "percentile_approx(current_portfolio_rent, 0.5) as med"
).collect()[0]["med"]

if not global_city_price_median or global_city_price_median <= 0:
    global_city_price_median = DEFAULT_GLOBAL_PRICE_MEDIAN

if not global_city_portfolio_median or global_city_portfolio_median <= 0:
    global_city_portfolio_median = DEFAULT_GLOBAL_PORTFOLIO_MEDIAN

print(f"Global city price median: {global_city_price_median}")
print(f"Global city portfolio median: {global_city_portfolio_median}")

# --------------------------------------------------
# Room-type ratio within city
# ratio = median_group_price / median_city_price
# capped to avoid extreme uplift/discount
# --------------------------------------------------
train_df = train_df.withColumn(
    "room_type_ratio_raw",
    F.when(
        (F.col("median_group_price").isNotNull()) &
        (F.col("median_group_price") > 0) &
        (F.col("median_city_price").isNotNull()) &
        (F.col("median_city_price") > 0),
        F.col("median_group_price") / F.col("median_city_price")
    ).otherwise(F.lit(1.0))
)

train_df = train_df.withColumn(
    "room_type_ratio",
    F.when(F.col("room_type_ratio_raw") < 0.70, F.lit(0.70))
     .when(F.col("room_type_ratio_raw") > 1.30, F.lit(1.30))
     .otherwise(F.col("room_type_ratio_raw"))
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Build target directly on portfolio-rent scale
# --------------------------------------------------
train_df = train_df.withColumn(
    "market_rent_target_raw",
    F.coalesce(F.col("median_city_portfolio_rent"), F.lit(global_city_portfolio_median)) *
    F.col("room_type_ratio")
)

# Light quality adjustment from review score
train_df = train_df.withColumn(
    "quality_adjustment",
    F.when(F.col("review_scores_rating").isNull(), F.lit(1.0))
     .when(F.col("review_scores_rating") >= 95, F.lit(1.05))
     .when(F.col("review_scores_rating") <= 75, F.lit(0.95))
     .otherwise(F.lit(1.0))
)

train_df = train_df.withColumn(
    "market_rent_target_raw",
    F.col("market_rent_target_raw") * F.col("quality_adjustment")
)

# Final stable target bounds
train_df = train_df.withColumn(
    "market_rent_target",
    F.when(F.col("market_rent_target_raw") < MIN_TARGET_RENT, F.lit(MIN_TARGET_RENT))
     .when(F.col("market_rent_target_raw") > MAX_TARGET_RENT, F.lit(MAX_TARGET_RENT))
     .otherwise(F.col("market_rent_target_raw"))
)

# Train on log1p(target)
train_df = train_df.withColumn(
    "label",
    F.log1p(F.col("market_rent_target"))
)

print("Calibration summary:")
train_df.select(
    F.min("price").alias("min_price"),
    F.max("price").alias("max_price"),
    F.expr("percentile_approx(price, 0.5)").alias("median_price"),
    F.min("market_rent_target").alias("min_market_rent_target"),
    F.max("market_rent_target").alias("max_market_rent_target"),
    F.expr("percentile_approx(market_rent_target, 0.5)").alias("median_market_rent_target"),
    F.min("label").alias("min_label"),
    F.max("label").alias("max_label")
).show(truncate=False)

print("Sample benchmark rows:")
train_df.select(
    "city",
    "room_type",
    "price",
    "median_group_price",
    "median_city_price",
    "median_city_portfolio_rent",
    "room_type_ratio_raw",
    "room_type_ratio",
    "quality_adjustment",
    "market_rent_target"
).show(20, truncate=False)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Fit encoders on training set
# --------------------------------------------------
print("Fitting StringIndexer models...")

city_indexer = StringIndexer(
    inputCol="city",
    outputCol="city_idx",
    handleInvalid="keep"
)

room_type_indexer = StringIndexer(
    inputCol="room_type",
    outputCol="room_type_idx",
    handleInvalid="keep"
)

city_model = city_indexer.fit(train_df)
room_type_model = room_type_indexer.fit(train_df)

train_df = city_model.transform(train_df)
train_df = room_type_model.transform(train_df)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Final model dataset
# First column must be label for SageMaker built-in XGBoost
# --------------------------------------------------
model_df = train_df.select(
    F.col("label").cast("double").alias("label"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("city_idx"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("city_idx"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("room_type_idx"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("room_type_idx"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("minimum_nights"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("minimum_nights"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("availability_365"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("availability_365"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("number_of_reviews"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("number_of_reviews"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("review_scores_rating"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("review_scores_rating"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("latitude"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("latitude"),
    F.coalesce(F.col("longitude"), F.lit(0.0)).cast("double").alias("longitude")
)

print("Final training feature schema:")
model_df.printSchema()

print("Sample training rows:")
model_df.show(10, truncate=False)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Train / validation split
# --------------------------------------------------
train_final, val_final = model_df.randomSplit([0.8, 0.2], seed=42)

print("Training rows:", train_final.count())
print("Validation rows:", val_final.count())

# --------------------------------------------------
# Write CSV for SageMaker
# No header for built-in XGBoost
# --------------------------------------------------
print("Writing SageMaker training CSV...")
train_final.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").option("header", "false").csv(TRAIN_OUTPUT_PATH)

print("Writing SageMaker validation CSV...")
val_final.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").option("header", "false").csv(VALIDATION_OUTPUT_PATH)

print("Glue training export completed successfully.")
job.commit()
